scope: The six existing Fresno river review groups, including county boundary reaches; not complete county coverage.
basis: Explicit nearby NWS planning samples provide wind context, not uniform conditions across a reach. Utility polygons are tested only at the configured gauge, reservoir and wind points in EPSG:4326. No river corridor polygons, buffers or nearest-outage assignments are inferred.

areas.note: Three samples along the Friant–Mendota boundary reach; conditions between samples are unknown.
No wind sample is assigned to the Redinger reach. Shaver Lake is not substituted.
Friant vicinity wind context only; this point is not a survey of Little Dry Creek or its facilities.
One James Bypass planning sample; conditions elsewhere along the bypass are unknown.
Trimmer wind context only; the upstream North Fork and mountain approaches are not fully sampled.
Pine Flat Dam vicinity sample; downstream Kings distributaries and facilities are not fully sampled.
